title: A Cat Was A Town's Mayor For 20 Years 🐈
caption:
A cat was a town's mayor for 20 years 🐈
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. Stubbs the cat was the honorary mayor of Talkeetna, Alaska, from 1997 until he died in 2017. The town has no human mayor because it is unincorporated, and tourists came from all over to meet him.
Would you vote for a cat? 👇
first_comment: No scandals, no broken promises, twenty years in office. Best politician ever? 🐈👇
